Generic five-door hatchback with a two-box roofline, a steep tailgate and taillight clusters at the rear corners. Its paint is a neutral near-white, so a scene can tint each instance.

Generic four-door sedan with a low beltline, a notch-back deck and a full-width rear light bar. Authored as the drivable car of the Golden Gate scene, so its rear stays clean for a chase camera; the paint is a neutral near-white for scene tinting.
Generic five-door SUV with a tall, square greenhouse, raised ground clearance, larger wheel arches and a steep liftgate. Its paint is a neutral near-white for scene tinting.
Generic crew-cab pickup truck with a short bed. Made for traffic seen from about 3 m to 1 km, it steps from a detailed cab down to a boxy silhouette across three tiers.
Generic class 6 cab-over box truck with dual rear wheels. The cab takes the paint tint; the cargo box has its own untinted near-white material.
Generic 40 ft low-floor transit bus with two doors on the right, a two-tone body (paint above, trim below), dual rear wheels and a roof equipment pod. No operator livery, text or numbers.
